About Me

About Me

I'm a pre-final year B.Tech Computer Science Engineering student at VIT-AP University, Amaravati, specializing in Machine Learning, Computer Vision, and Generative AI. I enjoy combining strong programming fundamentals with practical, real-world builds — from detection systems to reinforcement-learning agents.

My academic journey centers around bridging classroom concepts with hands-on projects. I've implemented real-time object detection with YOLOv8, trained reinforcement-learning agents, built NLP pipelines, and recently completed IBM's Advanced Generative AI certification — deepening my grasp of modern LLM-driven systems.

As an active problem solver and Technical Coordinator at my university's Milestone Club, I lead event execution and team coordination, preparing to step into roles at the intersection of applied AI/ML and full-stack software engineering.

Document Intelligence

DocuMind — Document Summary Assistant

A local-first document intelligence web app that turns lengthy PDF and image-based documents into structured, multi-level summaries. Built for a company assignment/selection process: FastAPI backend with PyMuPDF + Tesseract OCR extraction, a TF-IDF-based extractive summarization pipeline (short/medium/long summaries, key points, readability stats, important terms), and SQLite-backed local analysis history — no external AI API required.
